name.en-US: Christian Counsel on Divers Matters Pertaining to the Inner Life
name.pt-BR: Conselhos Cristãos sobre Diversos Assuntos da Vida Interior

author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.en-US: Thirty-one chapters of Fénelon's counsel on the inner life: the knowledge and love of God, pure love, prayer and meditation, mortification, self-abandonment, temptations, silence, the cross and the presence of God, in the Metcalf version of Spiritual Progress.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e um capítulos de Fénelon sobre a vida interior: conhecimento e amor de Deus, amor puro, oração e meditação, mortificação, abandono, tentações, silêncio, a cruz e a presença de Deus, na versão de Metcalf.

en-US.editor: James W. Metcalf (New York: M. W. Dodd, 1853)

sources.edition: Spiritual Progress, ed. James W. Metcalf (New York: M. W. Dodd, 1853), CCEL proofed etext; only Fénelon's parts.
sources.description: Fénelon's part of the volume only; the Guyon and La Combe pieces and the editor's preface are left out. Gutenberg licence and transcriber notes are dropped. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon died in 1715 and the edition is of 1853, so the text is public domain.
